race.comment: VON ROMMEL (4) has done everything right in two starts and looks the runner with the most upside. He won a Mdn at Northam on debut after having difficulty obtaining clear running, then stepped straight to CL3 company at this track and was third, beaten a length. That form reads well coming back to a CL1 and he can get back to winning ways. ARIZONA SKY (1) resumed with a second in a CL3 at Northam despite big odds, and his 1400m record gives him a genuine winning platform. Maps to get his chance and can strike second-up. BEAU'S A LAD (5) has the ratings profile to threaten and his Ascot fifth in CL3 grade had some merit after interference, though his long 1400m record is the reservation. BLUE SPARX (7) is better placed after being safely held in the Listed Fairetha Stakes and his one win and one place from two starts at this track keep him in the mix. BARRON BILL (2) is on the quick turnaround and can improve third-up.
